caption.text: Part 3 of REDIS DATA TYPES. Most Redis outages are not Redis being slow — they are one O(N) command holding a single-threaded server hostage while 500 clients wait. This handbook walks all five core types: their internal encodings, the commands worth memorising, the Big-O of each, and the exact mistakes (KEYS *, SMEMBERS, HGETALL on a 100k-field bucket) that turn a cache into a stall. Ten pages, from the flat keyspace to SLOWLOG.
